description: One candidate of a mofsift bundle. null means the value was not computed.

accessible_surface_m2_cm3.description: Surface accessible to the probe. Unit: m2/cm3.

accessible_surface_m2_g.description: Surface accessible to the probe. Unit: m2/g.

accessible_volume_cm3_g.description: Volume accessible to the centre of the probe. Unit: cm3/g.

accessible_volume_fraction.description: Fraction of the cell volume accessible to the centre of the probe.

c_fraction.description: C atoms as a fraction of all atoms.

cif_path.description: Path of the structure file, relative to the folder that holds the table.

density.description: Density from the cell and the atomic masses. Unit: g/cm3.

describe_composition_skip_reason.description: Why, when the status is not ok.

describe_composition_status.description: Whether the composition descriptors were computed: ok, skipped or failed.

describe_geometry_skip_reason.description: Why, when the status is not ok.

describe_geometry_status.description: Whether the pore geometry was computed: ok, skipped or failed.

describe_xtb_skip_reason.description: Why, when the status is not ok.

describe_xtb_status.description: Whether the xTB calculation ran: ok, skipped or failed.

edges.description: Edge building blocks, + between several; empty without edges.

expected_formula.description: Sum of the building blocks; empty for existing CIFs.

filter_pass.description: The row satisfies every filter of the config. Empty when there are no filters.

filter_rejected_by.description: The filters the row did not satisfy, with the missing columns when undecided.

filter_skip_reason.description: Why, when the status is not ok.

filter_status.description: Whether the filters were applied: ok, skipped or failed.

formula.description: Formula of the unit cell, Hill order.

generate_skip_reason.description: Why, when the status is not ok.

generate_status.description: Whether the structure was built or read: ok, skipped or failed.

h_fraction.description: H atoms as a fraction of all atoms.

has_open_shell_3d_metal.description: The primary metal is Ti-Cu. A flag on the composition, not a computed spin state.

heteroatom_fraction.description: N, O, S, F, Cl, Br and I atoms as a fraction of all atoms.

id.description: Record ID; the key of the table. It depends only on what defines the candidate.

lcd.description: Largest cavity diameter (largest included sphere). Unit: angstrom.

lcd_free_path.description: Largest included sphere along the free-sphere path. Unit: angstrom.

linker_rotatable_bonds.description: Rotatable bonds of the linker. Smaller is better.

linker_sa.description: SA score of the linker, 1 (easy) to 10 (hard). Smaller is better.

linker_sc.description: SCScore of the linker, 1 (simple) to 5 (complex). Smaller is better.

linker_size.description: Heavy atoms of the linker. Smaller is better.

linker_smiles.description: Canonical SMILES of the linkers when they are known, ; between several.

mean_atomic_number.description: Mean atomic number over all atoms.

mean_electronegativity.description: Mean Pauling electronegativity over all atoms.

metal_fraction.description: Metal atoms as a fraction of all atoms.

n_fraction.description: N atoms as a fraction of all atoms.

n_metal_atoms.description: Metal atoms in the unit cell.

n_transition_metal_atoms.description: d-block atoms in the unit cell.

name.description: Readable label: topology__nodes__edges, or the file name.

node_rmsd.description: Largest node-to-vertex misfit reported by PORMAKE. Unit: angstrom.

o_fraction.description: O atoms as a fraction of all atoms.

pld.description: Pore limiting diameter (largest free sphere). Unit: angstrom.

precedent_linker.description: Distinct synthesised MOFs in the reference with this linker. Larger is better.

precedent_node.description: Distinct synthesised MOFs in the reference with this primary metal. Information only: it does not separate synthesised from hypothetical MOFs.

precedent_pair.description: Distinct synthesised MOFs in the reference with this linker and metal. Larger is better.

precedent_topology.description: Distinct synthesised MOFs in the reference with this topology. Larger is better.

qc_composition_ok.description: The formula equals the sum of the building blocks.

qc_n_bad_c.description: C atoms with fewer than 2 or more than 4 non-metal neighbours.

qc_n_bad_h.description: H atoms that do not have exactly one neighbour.

qc_n_close_pairs.description: Pairs of atoms closer than qc.min_distance.

qc_n_components.description: Connected components of the bond network.

qc_n_overlaps.description: Heavy-heavy or H-H pairs closer than qc.min_distance_heavy.

qc_n_short_bonds.description: Compressed covalent bonds (reported, not a check).

qc_node_rmsd_ok.description: The node misfit is within qc.max_node_rmsd.

qc_pass.description: No enabled structural check failed. Not a statement about stability or synthesis.

qc_skip_reason.description: Why, when the status is not ok.

qc_status.description: Whether the checks ran: ok, skipped or failed.

score_aggregate.description: Weighted mean rank of the chosen components within one table, 0 (worst) to 1 (best). Not a probability, and not comparable between tables.

score_notes.description: Why a component is empty for this row.

score_skip_reason.description: Why, when the status is not ok.

score_status.description: Whether at least one component was computed: ok, skipped or failed.

source.description: Where the structure comes from: pormake or cifs.

source_file.description: Original file inside cif_dir; empty for assembled structures.

std_atomic_number.description: Spread of the atomic number over all atoms.

std_electronegativity.description: Spread of the Pauling electronegativity over all atoms.

topology.description: Net the structure was assembled on; empty for existing CIFs.

xtb_gap.description: xtb_lumo minus xtb_homo from periodic GFN-xTB. A proxy, not a DFT or measured band gap; comparable between rows only when xtb_unpaired_electrons is 0. Unit: eV.

xtb_homo.description: Highest doubly occupied level. Unit: eV.

xtb_lumo.description: Lowest level that is not doubly occupied. Unit: eV.

xtb_unpaired_electrons.description: Unpaired electrons used in the calculation (a rule of thumb, not computed).

zeo_high_accuracy.description: Zeo++ accuracy setting that produced this row: OCC, DEF or off.

title: mofsift candidate record
